verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS auth service with a dashboard, but nothing in the evidence pack documents one inside Supabase Auth. The llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI probes only make the docs and API machine-readable; they are not an in-product assistant users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
